device: Ascend910_9392 / dav-2201, 48 vector cores as reported by existing runs
scope: Source analysis and existing PMU/native evidence only. No optimization implemented or ready staged.

complexity.frequency: O(C*D) per invocation for fixed-degree Device math; frequency regenerated independently by each participating core.
complexity.angles_trig: Ideal O(T*D), shared across heads. Token/core boundary overlap adds at most C-1 repeated tokens for contiguous unsplit head jobs; batching can evaluate zero-position angles speculatively.
complexity.rotation: O(T*H*D): 4 multiplications + 2 additions per pair = 3*M FLOPs; casts/masks/indexing are additional.
complexity.minimum_gm: 2*q*M + 4*T logical bytes; actual position load instructions and memory transactions exceed logical positions bytes.
complexity.arithmetic_intensity: Rotation alone: 3/(2*q) FLOP/GM-byte = 0.75 FP16, 0.375 FP32. This excludes trig/init and does not establish the critical pipeline.
complexity.time_lower_bound: Launch + unhidden startup + steady-state max(MTE2 demand, MTE3 demand, UB/VEC demand, scalar issue demand), plus dependency/tail effects. Frequency generation may overlap the first prefetch in aligned paths. Do not sum overlapping PMU percentages or treat this qualitative model as measured stage timing.

precision_chain.contract: e=round32(i/W); u=round32(theta**e); f=round32(1/u); a=round32(p*f); s/c=FP32 trig(a); products/addition rounded FP32; FP16 RINT cast last. Exact real inverse power is not the same rounding chain.
precision_chain.local_bounds: |delta_angle| <= |p|*|delta_freq| + product rounding. For normal finite values, |delta_sin| and |delta_cos| <= |delta_angle| plus trig evaluation error. |delta_y| <= |a_input|*|delta_c|+|b_input|*|delta_s| plus product/add rounding.
precision_chain.fp16_boundary: No amplitude-independent absolute-error bound survives a discontinuous FP16 cast unless the perturbed FP32 values remain in the same rounding bin. For |y| in [32768,65504], adjacent finite half values are 32 apart.
precision_chain.range: V9 reduces by nearest 2*pi quotient, three split constants, scales by 1/4, evaluates a degree-9 sine polynomial, derives quarter cosine using sqrt, then reconstructs full angle by double-angle identities.
precision_chain.limitation: For theta<1, angle can exceed 131072 because inv_freq>1; the position bound alone is not an angle bound. FP32 extremes, overflow and int32 quotient range require a separate domain audit before replacing trig globally.

reuse.allowed: Within invocation: frequency across local tokens, token sin/cos across heads and UB token batches. All values derived from current theta/positions on Device.
reuse.boundary: No portable global synchronization is present. Independent cores repeat init and boundary-token trig; sharing across cores requires a separately proven single-kernel synchronization/design, not an extra launch.
reuse.lut: A full runtime sin/cos table over p=0..131072 uses 2*131073*W*4 bytes: ~512 MiB at D1024, and O(131073*D) work each call. Precomputed/cross-invocation generated result tables are forbidden. Existing UB trig batching is already legal reuse.
reuse.alternatives: Rotate-half and complex multiply have the same 4 mul/2 add core. Gauss 3-multiply rearrangements add extra additions and alter rounding; no measured support. Recurrence depends on positions and accumulated error; arbitrary input positions provide no guaranteed recurrence.
reuse.no_hidden_shapes: Model dispatch uses public shape/dtype/theta only. No mapping from platform testcase number to shape is inferred.

source_operation_model.note: Logical source operand bytes, excluding broadcasts/repeat-lane utilization and compiler/hardware effects. Both wide rotation variants have the same arithmetic FLOPs and nominal operand bytes; changed vmadd/vmla operand placement/throughput is supported by timing, not a proven reduction in GM traffic.

pipeline_models.flow: two strided half-column GM loads -> cast -> 5 work arrays -> 4mul/2add -> cast -> two strided stores
pipeline_models.queues: in1/out1; PIPE_ALL per job; no inter-job DMA overlap
pipeline_models.reuse: frequency range per core; one token sin/cos reused for local head jobs
pipeline_models.risk: extra bursts, padded masks and replicated position loads offset added column parallelism

pipeline_models.flow: two strided half loads -> padded halves -> replicated cos/sin UB -> 4mul/2add; reload original first half in UB for second output -> two stores
pipeline_models.reuse: one-token trig per core, copied over padded head rows
pipeline_models.risk: noncontiguous DMA, padding, explicit UB copies and low queue overlap

pipeline_models.types: reachable main branch FP16 D<512 many-head; FP32 uses DirectFloat
pipeline_models.flow: contiguous whole-head load -> half cast into z -> 2Mul+2MulAddDst into r -> half cast -> whole-head store; D<=64 large head tile uses full-cos specialization
pipeline_models.queues: in2/out2; prefetch next job before compute, final PIPE_ALL
pipeline_models.reuse: batch<=16, capped by 188KiB; frequency scratch reuses work arrays
pipeline_models.risk: cache growth competes with head-tile/queue space; full-cos changes mask utilization

pipeline_models.types: reachable FP16 aligned D>=512 many-head; FP32 uses DirectFloat
pipeline_models.flow: same two-work-array rotation, work stride=size+8; D>512 wide entry selects same class
pipeline_models.queues: in2/out1; next input prefetched; one output slot may serialize later store ownership
pipeline_models.reuse: batch<=16 subject to UB; no cross-call results
pipeline_models.risk: VEC-bound D1024 measured, not a demonstrated HBM limit

pipeline_models.types: FP32 aligned, except H1 token-batched path
pipeline_models.flow: GM load into input queue used directly as z -> output queue r -> GM; no separate cast or z/r work buffers
pipeline_models.queues: in2/out2, output tensor temporarily supplies trig/frequency scratch; next-input prefetch
pipeline_models.reuse: batch<=min(16, size/(2*freq_size)); trig scratch must finish before output overwrite
pipeline_models.risk: cannot directly transplant half wide dataflow without rechecking UB liveness

pipeline_models.types: FP16/FP32 aligned H1 T>=16, unless bulk-position
pipeline_models.flow: multiple tokens -> per-row scalar position angles -> batched trig -> 3 FP32 work arrays, 4mul/2add -> cast -> GM
pipeline_models.queues: in2/out2, prefetch, p0 rows copied back from original input
pipeline_models.reuse: frequency across all local token tiles; no head reuse possible
pipeline_models.risk: trig dominates at H1; per-row scalar GetValue and casts remain

pipeline_models.flow: batched token/position DMA -> cast positions -> Brcb/Copy -> trig/rotation -> Select zero mask -> store
pipeline_models.reuse: frequency across tile; vector position expansion removes per-token scalar loads
pipeline_models.risk: broadcast copies/zero masks add VEC/UB traffic

pipeline_models.types: FP16/FP32 narrow D, small H; token-batched
pipeline_models.flow: contiguous GM -> device-generated Gather indices -> unpack halves/trig broadcast -> rotation -> Gather packing -> GM
pipeline_models.queues: in2/out2 with explicit VEC barriers for Gather dependencies
pipeline_models.reuse: frequency and indexes per core; token trig broadcast across heads
pipeline_models.risk: 6 FP32 capacity arrays + 5 index arrays + mask; index startup/Gather can outweigh saved DMA

pipeline_models.flow: contiguous head-tile load -> Gather pair packing -> broadcast trig -> rotation -> repack -> store
pipeline_models.reuse: one token trig per core and head jobs; indexes once
pipeline_models.risk: same heavy index/UB footprint as Packed; tail rows need masks

bottleneck_conclusions: Tiny: scalar ratio 76.46%, VEC 19.02%, eight blocks. Supports initialization/control/occupancy concern, but PMU does NOT isolate frequency initialization duration.
DeepSeek FP16: VEC 70.98%, MTE2 61.07%, MTE3 28.78%. Mixed compute/input path, all overlap; target shared UB/compute changes only after numerical correctness is resolved.

Wide FP16: VEC 86.32%, MTE2 25.07%, MTE3 13.94%. Existing isolated wide dataflow lowers VEC time 26.3444 -> 23.6691us and paired native 31.981 -> 29.2805us (~1.0922x). Preserve evidence; currently precision-blocked by V9-inherited failure.

Stream: MTE2 93.72%, MTE3 63.88%, VEC 47.13%. Source reads/writes once; existing native 841.226us for 1GiB minimum tensor I/O implies ~1.276TB/s effective traffic, not an independently measured hardware bandwidth ceiling.

Installed disassembler cannot decode HiIPU instructions; API-to-intrinsic mappings and measured rounding exist. Do not invent instruction counts, bank-conflict causes or I-cache bottlenecks (recorded I-cache misses are zero).
Native fixed-input ABBA+BAAB decides performance; profiling replay durations above explain utilization only. No new performance tasks were run for this diagnostic.
